decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposal is considered acceptable having due regard to the site characteristics and would not harm the appearance of the Unit or the area's character or impair the safety of other road and footway users, and would provide satisfactory access for people with disabilities.  It therefore complies with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), E.2.3 (Improvement of Employment Sites), E.3.1 (Disabled Access) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003, and 'Think Access - Design for Accessibility (2000)' Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The crosshatching shown on drawing 306 05 to the rear of the disabled car parking spaces and disabled ramps shall be carried out within six months from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is used).

Condition : 4 - INFORMATIVE: An additional two poster display signs to those approved under reference 00505/V/AD13 have been erected on the front elevation and two windows placed in the northern flank wall of the building.  Retrospective planning permission for their retention should therefore be submitted.
description: Retention of 2 x disabled ramps to front elevation and re-marked car parking bays to front of existing building.
